entities.summary: KeyHoleTV is an online television portal that links to Japanese television channels, radio stations, and user-made channels. KeyHoleTV only has a narrow selection of channels, such as TV Asahi, NHK General TV, NHK Educational TV, Fuji TV, TBS, TV Tokyo, Tokyo MX and Nippon TV. Most are analog and some of the applied channels are password protected. However, it does have the US Military's AM radio station in Japan AFN Tokyo Eagle 810.
